findings.issue: fit_and_score defaults to include_test=True, and the plain `make train` / `make all` path (line 138) scores and prints the H2-2012 test set on every run. Test metrics are already in reports/metrics.json. Only the --target-transform runs hide the test set unless --final is given. CLAUDE.md says test scoring needs the user's say-so and runs only once.
findings.why_it_matters: The split is correctly temporal: train 2011-01-10..2011-12-31, valid 2012-01-01..06-30, test 2012-07-01..12-31, and transformers are fit on train only. But test scores show up on every routine run. Any feature or hyperparameter change made after looking at metrics.json is then implicitly tuned on the test set. That undermines the 'never tune on test' rule and the honesty of the reported test R^2.

findings.issue: `make all` is documented as reproducing 'every number in REPORT.md', but REPORT.md does not exist in the repo.
findings.why_it_matters: I re-ran `make all` and it reproduces reports/metrics.json exactly, with HGB random_state=0 and pinned requirements. But there is no reported write-up to check against, so the claim that the reported numbers can be reproduced cannot be verified as documented.
